summary: FEAT-0022 depends on three proposed-status features that have not been accepted.
detail: FEAT-0022 lists depends-on: FEAT-0011, FEAT-0012, FEAT-0013, FEAT-0016, FEAT-0020. FEAT-0011, FEAT-0012, and FEAT-0013 are all status: proposed. CLAUDE.md states explicitly that only accepted features drive work. FEAT-0022 cannot be accepted until that ordering resolves.
recommendation: Either explicitly note in §Open Questions or §Success Criteria that acceptance is gated on FEAT-0011/0012/0013 acceptance and sequence those first, or scope FEAT-0022 down to a slice that only requires already-accepted features (memory and routing decisions tied to run artifacts) and defer the Workflow Extensions section.
disposition_rationale: Moved FEAT-0011/0012/0013 from hard dependencies to related and added an explicit acceptance-gating/phasing note for workflow extensions.

summary: §Workflow Extensions reframes how skills and agent teams operate without coordinating revisions to FEAT-0012/0013.
detail: FEAT-0022 says skills, hooks, slash commands, and agent teams should align with workflow contracts and agent teams execute as runs with multiple coordinated agents. That is a meaningful reframing of what skills and agent teams are. FEAT-0012 currently treats skills as a harness-side capability; FEAT-0013 treats agent teams as multi-agent orchestration. Under FEAT-0022, both become specializations of the durable-run model. The non-goals say this feature does not replace FEAT-0012 or FEAT-0013, but the relationship is more than additive — it is a re-anchoring.
recommendation: Add a §Cross-Feature Impact subsection naming exactly which sections of FEAT-0012 and FEAT-0013 are reframed by this spec, and either revise those specs in lockstep or sequence FEAT-0022 to be accepted before FEAT-0012/0013. The peer-review findings on FEAT-0012 already flag that FEAT-0012 should be split — that work and FEAT-0022 should converge on the same model.
disposition_rationale: Added a Cross-Feature Impact section explaining how FEAT-0012 skills and FEAT-0013 teams are re-anchored to durable runs.
